# dev-api

Always run the suite before opening the PR.

sourceActionId.description: The patch `proposed_action` that produced this version, if there was one.

sourceHypothesisId.description: The Psychologist's hypothesis that motivated the patch — the closed loop.

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the version in effect.

diff.description: Diff of this version against the previous one, computed server-side so the UI does not need its own differ. The oldest one is diffed against empty, so it shows up as all-addition.

content.example: Always run the suite before opening the PR.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, event, or version does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
